title: Page 7
lines: 「好，我先说。」如斯深吸了一口气，把想了一个晚上的话不疾不徐的说出口，「过一阵子我要去美国出差，我们可以趁这段时间好好冷静想想。」
他没急着接话，依旧定定的看着她。
时间一分一秒过去，在她以为他并不打算开口时，他缓缓扬声——
「想什么？」几个字像从石头缝里挤出来。
「想自己到底要的是什么。」她很快回答。
闻言，龚昊天死死盯着她，嘴唇抿成愤怒的一条直线。
「国中时你帮过我，然后我们谈了一场恋爱。」如斯看着他，续道：「你就当自己是许仙，以前救过我，我为了报恩，跟你谈了一场恋爱，现在互不相欠，你想跟蒋婷悦在一起，就大大方方在一起，我不是你拒绝她的理由，你对我没有忠诚的必要，好好选择真爱，不要误入歧途。」
「你跟我在一起是为了报恩，所以我没有忠诚的必要？」龚昊天胸膛起伏越来越剧烈，眼底怒火跳跃。
「不是你说的那样，我只是想说，你不欠我什么……」面对他的怒火，她努力保持镇定，把自己的想法表达清楚，「我们互不欠，你是自由的，不用因为我们现在是情侣而有所顾忌，你可以选择你真心想要的人。」
「我真心想要的人？」龚昊天盯着她足足半分钟，突然发狂大笑，然而这样的笑却比哭还难看，「我们互不相，我是自由的？！」
她到底知不道自己在说什么？他做错什么，需要她用这些话来惩罚他？
「你刚才想说什么？」如斯被他看得浑身发热，故意找了个问题问他，希望能打破两人之间诡异的气氛。
龚昊天深吸口气，没说话，拿出手机拨打，按下扩音键……
龚昊天拨出的电话很快被接起。
「昊天？我就知道你今晚会打给我，你在哪里，我过去找你好不好？」手机那头传来能滴出蜜来的声音。
如斯听见传出的女声，起身就走。
见她动作，龚昊天迅速起身，一手紧紧扣住她左手腕。
她挣扎了两下，反被他握得更牢，眼见走不了，她只好瞪他。
「蒋婷悦，我什么时候送你钻石耳环了？」龚昊天说这些话时，双眼直勾勾盯着如斯，承接来自于她的瞪视。
「昊天，你在哪里，我去找你，当面和你说清楚好不好？」蒋婷悦声音放柔，语气充满讨好。
「婷悦，我跟你不可能旧情复燃。」龚昊天看着如斯眼里的抗拒慢慢消退，紧绷的下颚稍微放松。
「任何事都有可能，你看孙如斯不也和吴卫然重修旧好？我们也一定可以……」蒋婷悦接着扯谎。
「抱歉，我没喜欢过你。」龚昊天态度强硬的打断她的话，「当初你跟我告白，我没拒绝，是因为你是校花，但我对你没感觉，后来你跑去联谊，老实说我松了口气，所以你不用觉得伤害了我而感到抱歉，能伤害我的女人只有孙如斯，你听懂了吗？」
「龚昊天，那个女人有什么好！」蒋婷悦在手机那头放声低吼。
「我也说不清她哪里好，但我就是离不开她，没有人能代替她在我心中的地位。」他说这话时，双眼定定地瞅着如斯。
这几句话与其说是对蒋婷说说的，不如说是讲给如斯听的。
如斯看着他，对他而言，这几白话大概就是「我爱你」了。她不再企图抽回手，任由他紧紧握着。
「就算她跟吴卫然又搞在一起？」蒋婷悦的用语越来越难听，「昊天，你清醒一点好不好？那个女人就是离不开吴卫然，才一直待在公司不走，我不信你看不岀来，就算这样你还是离不开她吗？！」
如斯双眼一眯，顿时怒气攻心。这个蒋婷悦脑袋到底哪里有毛病，明有没有的事，她也可以说得好像真的一样。
见她眼底窜怒，龚昊天反而放心地笑了。
「离不开。」他抢在蒋掉悦再次开口前，率先表态。
此话一出，如斯眼底跳窜的怒火散了，染上一层迷蒙。他知不知道自己在说什么？
「龚昊天，你到底有什么毛病？！」蒋婷悦气得尖叫。
「爱上一个人本来就是一种神经病。」龚昊天盯着如斯，越笑越开心，越笑越狂。
「龚昊天你……」蒋婷悦气到几乎说不出话来。
「我跟你不可能，以后别再找我。」龚昊天说完，潇洒的结束通话，往后抛开手机，手略一施力，将如斯扯入怀中，紧紧抱着。
许久后，她才听见头顶飘来他的轻哼声——
「舌头被猫咬掉了？」
「我没跟吴卫然旧情复燃。」如斯的额头抵着他的胸膛，闷闷地说。
「就算旧情复燃也没什么。」他说话时胸膛微微起伏。
「是吗？」她双手抵住他胸口，仰头看他。
龚昊天低头深深凝望着她，斩钉截铁地道：「我会把你抢回来。」
「你不用抢，抢也没用。」如斯推开他，重新坐回沙发上。
他不由得一愣，她这话是什么意思？
「握在手里的东西，懂得珍惜就好，干么抢？」她拿起桌上两个钻石耳环抛向空中。
「如斯。」他一手精准抓住两个钻石耳环，在她身边坐下。
「嗯？」她漫不经心哼了哼。
「嫁给我？」龚昊天摊开她的左手，把其中一个钻石耳环放到她掌心里，认真的眼神紧追着她四处飘移的目光。
她不愿意？
「等我从美国回来后给你答复。」如斯握紧掌心，收下钻石耳环。
「为什么？」他松了口气，至少她不是正面拒绝，不过就算她拒，他也会继续卖向她求婚，直到她点头答应为止。
「刚才我不是说了，你有自由选择的机会，同样的我也有，如果这趟去美国出差，遇到比你更好的男人，说不定我会见异思迁。」如斯冲着他笑得一脸灿烂。
「你真敢说。」龚昊天摇头失笑。
「说不定还真敢做呢。」她又补充了一句，笑得痛快。
龚昊天定定地看着她，实在拿她没辙。
叮咚！叮咚！
等一下要赶机去美国，一早就忙得团团转，谁会跑来按门铃？
如斯抬头看了眼镜中正在刷牙的自己，迟疑了一下，举步往玄关走去，连探问也省了……
这个时间会跑来按她家门铃的人，似乎有他。
拉开门，看见是龚昊天，如斯什么也没说又踱回浴室。
「你在刷牙！」龚昊天像发现新大陆般兴奋起来。
用看猪头的眼神瞥他一眼，她决定假装没看到他大惊小怪的反应，继续完成她未完的工作。
「我第一次看你刷牙。」他仍兴致勃勃的在她身后，逼得她不得不回头瞪他一眼。
见龚昊天打算一起进入浴室，如斯警告地射去一眼后，关上浴室的门，等她再度
「如斯，你好了吗？」低沉磁性的嗓音带点兴奋地问。
在客厅？如斯闻声走过去，只见一桌子的早餐已被陈列好。
「快来吃，不然会赶不上飞机。」
她微蹙着眉头走过去，他今天似乎特别热衷他带来的早餐，莫非……她缓缓坐下来，一双眼毫不掩饰心中浓浓的疑问。
「怎么了？」见她只看不动，龚昊天困惑挑眉。她不喜欢吃这些吗？
摇摇头，如斯拿起眼前像是变形过后的小笼包就口，嗯，味道还不差，就是开状「别具匠心」了点。
看她开始吃起早点，龚昊天满意地拿着不知哪里变来的梳子，温柔地替她梳发，越来越长了，发丝冰冰凉凉，光滑细致，摸起来十分舒服。
content_en:
"Okay, let me talk first." He took a deep breath and spoke out what he had been thinking about all night. "I'm going to the United States for a business trip in a while. We can take this time to think about it calmly."
He didn't answer in a hurry, and still looked at her steadily.
Time passed by, and when she thought he didn't intend to speak, he slowly raised his voice——
"What are you thinking about?" The words seemed to be squeezed out from the cracks in the stone.
"Think about what you want." She answered quickly.
Hearing this, Gong Haotian stared at her, his lips pursed into an angry straight line.
"You helped me when I was in junior high school, and then we fell in love." Looking at him like this, he continued: "Just think of yourself as Xu Xian. You saved me before. In order to repay your kindness, I fell in love with you. Now we don't owe each other. If you want to be with Jiang Tingyue, just do it openly. I am not the reason for you to reject her. You have no need to be loyal to me. Choose true love well and don't go astray."
"You are with me to repay your kindness, so I don't have to be loyal?" Gong Haotian's chest rose and fell more and more violently, and his eyes were filled with anger.
"It's not what you said, I just want to say that you don't owe me anything..." Facing his anger, she tried to stay calm and express her thoughts clearly, "We don't owe each other. You are free. You don't have to worry because we are a couple now. You can choose the person you really want."
"The person I really want?" Gong Haotian stared at her for half a minute and suddenly laughed wildly. However, this kind of laughter was uglier than crying. "We don't know each other, and I am free?!"
Does she know what she is talking about? What had he done wrong that warranted her punishing him with these words?
"What did you want to say just now?" He was so excited that he looked at her and asked him a question, hoping to break the weird atmosphere between the two.
Gong Haotian took a deep breath and said nothing. He took out his mobile phone to make a call and pressed the speaker button...
Chapter 10(1)
The call made by Gong Haotian was quickly picked up.
"Haotian? I knew you would call me tonight. Where are you? Can I go find you?" A voice that could drip out of honey came from the other end of the phone.
Hearing the female voice, he got up and left.
Seeing her move, Gong Haotian quickly stood up and clasped her left wrist tightly with one hand.
She struggled twice, but his grip became tighter. Seeing that she couldn't move, she could only stare at him.
"Jiang Tingyue, when did I give you diamond earrings?" When Gong Haotian said these words, his eyes stared straight at this, receiving the glare from her.
"Haotian, where are you? I'll go find you and tell you in person, okay?" Jiang Tingyue's voice was soft and her tone was full of flattery.
"Tingyue, it's impossible for you and I to rekindle our old relationship." Gong Haotian watched as the resistance in his eyes slowly faded away, and his tense jaw relaxed slightly.
"Anything is possible. Don't you think Sun Rushi and Wu Weiran can get back together again? We can definitely do it..." Jiang Tingyue continued to lie.
"I'm sorry, I never liked you." Gong Haotian interrupted her with a strong attitude. "When you confessed to me, I didn't refuse because you were the school beauty, but I didn't have feelings for you. Later, you ran to join us. To be honest, I was relieved, so you don't have to feel sorry for hurting me. The only woman who can hurt me is Sun Rusi. Do you understand?"
"Gong Haotian, what's so good about that woman!" Jiang Tingyue roared on the other end of the phone.
"I can't tell what's good about her, but I just can't live without her. No one can replace her place in my heart." When he said this, his eyes were fixedly looking like this.
These words are not so much said to Jiang Ting as to this audience.
Looking at him like this, for him, these few spoken words may be "I love you". She no longer tried to pull her hand away, letting him hold it tightly.
"Even if she and Wu Weiran get together again?" Jiang Tingyue's words became more and more unpleasant, "Haotian, could you please wake up? That woman just can't leave Wu Weiran, that's why she stays in the company. I don't believe you can't see it. Even so, can you still not leave her?!"
His eyes narrowed like this, and he suddenly felt angry. What's wrong with Jiang Tingyue's head? She can tell it as if it's true.
Seeing the anger in her eyes, Gong Haotian smiled with relief.
"Can't do without." He took the lead in expressing his position before Jiang Tuoyue spoke again.
As soon as these words came out, the anger that was dancing in his eyes dissipated and became filled with a layer of mist. Does he know what he is talking about?
"Gong Haotian, what's wrong with you?!" Jiang Tingyue screamed angrily.
"Falling in love with someone is a kind of madness." Gong Haotian stared at this, the happier he became, the crazier he became.
"Gong Haotian, you..." Jiang Tingyue was so angry that she could hardly speak.
"It's impossible for me to be with you. Don't look for me again in the future." After Gong Haotian finished speaking, he ended the call gracefully, put the phone away, and with a little force, he pulled Rusi into his arms and held her tightly.
After a long time, she heard his soft hum floating above her head——
"Your tongue was bitten off by a cat?"
"I didn't rekindle my old relationship with Wu Weiran." Rusi pressed her forehead against his chest and said dully.
"It doesn't matter if old feelings rekindle." His chest rose slightly as he spoke.
"Really?" She put her hands on his chest and looked up at him.
Gong Haotian lowered his head and stared at her deeply, and said firmly: "I will take you back."
"You don't have to fight. It's useless to fight." She pushed him away and sat back on the sofa.
He couldn't help but be stunned, what did she mean?
"Just cherish the things you hold in your hands. Why grab them?" She picked up two diamond earrings on the table and threw them into the air.
"That's it." He accurately grasped the two diamond earrings with one hand and sat down next to her.
"Huh?" She hummed casually.
"Marry me?" Gong Haotian spread her left hand and put one of the diamond earrings into her palm, his serious eyes following her wandering gaze.
She doesn't want to?
"I'll give you an answer when I get back from the United States." She clenched her palms and accepted the diamond earrings.
"Why?" He breathed a sigh of relief. At least she didn't refuse directly, but even if she refused, he would continue to propose to her until she nodded in agreement.
"Didn't I just say that you have the opportunity to choose freely, and so do I. If I go to the United States on a business trip and meet a better man than you, maybe I will have different ideas." Rusi smiled brightly at him.
"How dare you say that." Gong Haotian shook his head and laughed.
"Maybe you really dare to do it." She added, smiling happily.
Gong Haotian looked at her intently, feeling that he had nothing to do with her.
Ding dong! Ding dong!
I have to catch a flight to the United States later. I am so busy in the morning. Who will come and ring the doorbell?
So he raised his head and looked at himself brushing his teeth in the glasses, hesitated for a moment, and walked towards the entrance, not even asking...
He seemed to be the one who came to ring her doorbell at this time.
When he opened the door and saw Gong Haotian, he walked back to the bathroom without saying anything.
"You are brushing your teeth!" Gong Haotian became excited as if he had discovered a new world.
Giving him a pig-headed look, she decided to pretend she didn't see his fussy reaction and continue to finish her unfinished work.
"This is the first time I've seen you brush your teeth." He was still behind her with great interest, forcing her to turn back and glare at him.
Seeing that Gong Haotian was planning to enter the bathroom together, he shot a warning glance, closed the bathroom door, and waited for her to come back again.
"So, are you okay?" the deep magnetic voice asked excitedly.
In the living room? Hearing this, he walked over and saw a table of breakfast already laid out.
"Come and eat, or you'll miss the plane."
She frowned slightly and walked over. He seemed to be particularly keen on the breakfast he brought today. Could it be... She sat down slowly, her eyes not hiding the deep doubts in her heart.
"What's wrong?" Seeing that she just stared at her, Gong Haotian raised his eyebrows in confusion. Doesn't she like eating these?
Shaking his head, he picked up the transformed xiaolongbao in front of him and chewed it. Well, the taste was not bad, but the shape was a bit "unique".
Seeing her starting to eat breakfast, Gong Haotian was satisfied with the comb he had obtained from somewhere and gently combed her hair. It was getting longer and longer. The hair was cold, smooth and delicate, and felt very comfortable to the touch.
